sloka: प्रवेशयत सम्भारान्माभूत्कालस्य पर्ययः ।अद्यैवाहं गमिष्यामि लक्ष्मणेन गतां गतिम् ।। ७.१०७.३ ॥
transliteration: praveśayata sambhārānmābhūtkālasya paryayaḥ ।adyaivāhaṁ gamiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇena gatāṁ gatim ।। 7.107.3 ॥

translations.english: Bring in the preparations, let there be no delay, for today itself I will follow the path that Lakshmana has taken.
